remarks: Don't miss this beautifully remodeled 2-bedroom, 1.5-bath townhouse in a prime location - just minutes from I-95, vibrant SONO, and picturesque Rowayton.  Step inside to find warm hardwood floors throughout and an open, flowing layout. The spacious living room connects seamlessly to the dining area and updated kitchen, creating a welcoming space for both everyday living and entertaining.  The kitchen features granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, a convenient breakfast bar, and clean white cabinetry for a fresh, modern feel.  Upstairs, you'll find two generously sized bedrooms with large closets, connected by a tastefully updated full bathroom designed with convenience and comfort in mind.  Enjoy outside maintenance, snow plowing, lawn mowing, garbage pickup and water being included in the rent.
